addDatesHelp: Choose several days and one start time. Each day becomes a draft performance that needs its own review.
applyHelp: Copy the ticket types and prices of {{when}} to other draft dates of this event.
applyNoTargets: There are no other draft dates with the same stock pools.
applyTargets: Draft dates to receive the pricing
applyWarning: Ticket types of the chosen dates are replaced. Sale windows move to each date. Only dates with identical stock pools qualify.
capacityHintHelp: Shown in the map editor as a reminder. A map larger than the hint still saves.
capacityWarning: The configured capacity ({{configured}}) is above the venue capacity hint ({{hint}}). You can still save.
createNewVenueHint: You can create a new venue below instead.
dateOutOfRange: Choose a date inside the allowed range.
dateTimeNeeded: Enter a valid date and time.
daysSkippedByClock: These days have no valid start at that time because of a clock change: {{days}}.
duplicateHelp: Creates a draft copy with the same venue space, map, stock pools and ticket types. Times and sale windows move by the same offset.
pauseHelp: Buyers cannot start new purchases while sales are paused. Platform operators see your reason. Existing holds and orders follow the standard rules.
proposedInvalid: Propose a start in the future and an end after it.
releaseChoice: When should this performance go public?
releaseOnApprovalHelp: It becomes public automatically after approval, as long as sales have not started yet.
requestHelp: TicketBox operations review your request. Nothing is cancelled or moved until an operator confirms it.
requestNoCommit: This sends a request only. You will see the decision here.
requestsHelp: Organizer requests to cancel or postpone released performances. Review one to confirm it in the disruption workflow, or decline it with a reason.
resumeHelp: Buyers can purchase again once TicketBox applies the change.
startInFuture: Choose a start in the future.
timeInvalid: Enter a valid time, for example 19:30.
venueLockHelp: Name and address stay fixed while a released or in-review performance uses this venue. City, time zone, capacity hint and spaces can still change.
venuesHelp: Edit your venues, add spaces and set the default time zone for new performances.
zone_ambiguous: This local time occurs twice when clocks change. Choose another time.
zone_nonexistent: This local time is skipped when clocks change. Choose another time.
